description: Use this when someone asks which vested RSU lots to sell first, in which years, to divest part of a concentrated company-stock position, compared on total computed tax: "I want to sell down half my Amazon stock; which lots, and when?". Given the vested lots (vest date, shares, cost basis), a current price, and a divest fraction, it compares WHICH lots and WHICH sale dates to use, by computed total tax, to divest that many shares, using three levers: specific-lot identification (sell higher-basis lots to realize less gain, or underwater lots to harvest losses that net against gains), long-term deferral (wait past the one-year mark to convert short-term ordinary rates to long-term capital gains), and multi-year bracket spreading (split gains across 1 to 3 tax years, with in-plan capital-loss carryforward). Every sale is priced at today's price (flat-price assumption; there is no growth model). Returns the year-by-year sell schedule grouped by tax year, the total tax (federal LTCG + NIIT + state), what a first-in-first-out (FIFO) oldest-first sell order on the same schedule would have cost (`headlineDeltaVsFifo`), a 1/2/3-year horizon trade-off, and per-lot deferral callouts. This tool owns WHICH LOTS and WHICH DATES; for WHETHER and HOW MUCH to sell down a position use `concentration_analyze`, for a single new vest use `rsu_sell_vs_hold`, and to raise a specific cash amount by a deadline use `equity_funding_plan`. Out of scope: growth/return modeling, wash-sale basis migration, AMT, unvested grants. Example: {lots: [{vestDate: "2022-08-15", shares: 120, costBasisPerShare: 95}, {vestDate: "2024-02-15", shares: 100, costBasisPerShare: 130}, {vestDate: "2026-05-15", shares: 80, costBasisPerShare: 210}], currentPrice: 180, divestFraction: 0.5, horizonYears: 2, ordinaryIncome: 200000, filingStatus: "single", stateCode: "CA"}. Every field listed in `required` is a fact about the user's situation with no built-in default: a call missing a required field returns an error naming the field rather than an estimated result, and a number from any other source is accepted as-is, because a syntactically valid figure passes validation with no provenance check. The math runs inside the tool with no randomness and no model inference. Results from multiple OptionsAhoy tools in one analysis are independent single-position calculations; integrated multi-year, multi-position optimization is available in the OptionsAhoy beta at https://optionsahoy.com/beta?src=mcp_multi.

currentPrice.description: Current share price, USD. Every sale, on every date, is priced at this value (flat-price assumption). This value must come from the user.

divestFraction.description: Fraction of TOTAL shares to divest, as a decimal (0.5 = sell half). Range 0.10 to 1.0. NOTE: a decimal fraction, NOT a percent, so pass 0.5 not 50. The tool sells round(divestFraction x totalShares) shares, floored at 1. The user's choice, not a modelling detail, and it changes the answer: use the value they gave, and if they gave none, ask for it rather than assuming one.

filingStatus.description: Federal filing status. Drives LTCG brackets, the NIIT threshold, and state bracket lookups.

horizonYears.description: Tax years the plan may span: 1 = sell everything now, 2, or 3. More years let the plan spread gains across brackets and defer short-term lots to long-term, at the cost of staying exposed to the stock longer. The user's choice, not a modelling detail, and it changes the answer: use the value they gave, and if they gave none, ask for it rather than assuming one.

lots.description: The vested RSU lots still held (after any sell-to-cover), one entry per vest tranche. The tool decides which of these to sell and when. Unvested grants are out of scope. At most 20 lots per call, the same cap the web calculator uses. With more tranches than that, combine the ones sharing a vest date and cost basis.

costBasisPerShare.description: Per-share cost basis, USD: the share price on vest day, which your broker's lot-detail page lists.

shares.description: Shares still held from this vest. Fractional allowed (dividend-reinvest / net-settlement lots).

vestDate.description: Date this lot vested (YYYY-MM-DD), on or before today. Drives long-term-vs-short-term status and the long-term-crossing sale date.

ordinaryIncome.description: Total household ordinary income for the year, USD, from all sources. Sets the federal LTCG bracket floor, the short-term ordinary rate, and the net investment income tax (NIIT) threshold test. This is taxable income after deductions, not gross wages: the engine applies no standard or itemized deduction to it. Assumed constant across plan years. Must come from the user.

stateCode.description: Two-letter US state code (e.g. CA, NY, TX). Drives state capital-gains treatment (CA taxes gains as ordinary; WA/TX/FL have no tax on most capital gains).

name: rsu_lot_optimize

outputSchema.description: RSU lot-order divest plan: which lots to sell on which dates to divest the target share count at the lowest total tax, versus a first-in-first-out (FIFO) sell order. All dollar amounts are USD.

attribution.description: Telescoping attribution of the total saving vs a FIFO-all-today sale. lotSelection + spreadingDeferral = total.

lotSelection.description: Saving from choosing which lots to sell (equals headlineDeltaVsFifo), in dollars.

spreadingDeferral.description: Saving from spreading sales across years and deferring for long-term status, in dollars. Can be <= 0 in loss-mix cases.

total.description: Total saving vs selling oldest-first, all today, in dollars.

carryforwardRemaining.description: Capital loss remaining at the end of the plan horizon, in dollars (reported, not modeled into future years).

items.description: A short-term lot that becomes long-term if its sale waits past longTermDate.

amountAtRisk.description: Position value kept exposed to the stock while waiting, in dollars.

daysToWait.description: Days from the planned sale date to longTermDate.

longTermDate.description: Date the lot becomes long-term, ISO date-time string (a sale strictly after the first vest anniversary).

lotIndex.description: 0-based index into the input lots array.

taxSaved.description: Tax saved by waiting for long-term treatment, in dollars.

headlineAfterTaxKept.description: After-tax proceeds under the plan, in dollars: the headline "you keep $X" figure.

headlineDeltaVsFifo.description: Dollars saved versus selling oldest-first (FIFO) on the SAME schedule. Pure lot-selection benefit; >= 0 by construction.

horizonCards.description: The same divest target under a 1-year ("all now"), 2-year, and 3-year plan, for the trade-off strip.

items.description: Total tax and after-tax proceeds for the same divest target under a given horizon.

afterTaxKept.description: After-tax proceeds from the divested shares under this horizon, in dollars.

horizonYears.description: Plan length in tax years (1 = sell all now, 2, or 3).

totalTax.description: Total plan tax under this horizon, in dollars.

keptUnrealizedGain.description: Unrealized gain still carried by the shares NOT sold, in dollars (deferred, not eliminated).

schedule.description: The sell plan, grouped by tax year.

items.description: All sales in one tax year, after Schedule D netting.

carryforwardGenerated.description: Capital loss carried into the next plan year from this year, in dollars (0 when the year nets positive).

effectiveRate.description: Year tax divided by year net gain, 0..1.

netLong.description: Net long-term gain or loss after netting, in dollars.

netShort.description: Net short-term gain or loss after netting, in dollars.

sales.description: Per-lot sale rows in this year.

items.description: One vested lot sold, in whole or part, on one date.

gainAmount.description: Realized capital gain, negative for a loss, in dollars.

grossProceeds.description: Gross sale proceeds in dollars (shares x current price; flat-price assumption).

isLongTerm.description: True when the lot was held more than one year at the sale date (long-term capital gain).

lotIndex.description: 0-based index into the input lots array this row draws from.

saleDate.description: Date this block is sold, ISO date-time string: today, a long-term-crossing date, or Jan 2 of a later plan year.

shares.description: Shares sold in this row (may be fractional).

taxAttributed.description: Signed tax attributed to this row in dollars; a loss row is negative (the tax it removes).

vestDate.description: Vest (acquisition) date of the lot, ISO date-time string.

year.description: Calendar tax year of the sale.

tax.description: Total tax for this year (federal + state + NIIT), in dollars.

sharesToSell.description: Shares the plan divests (round(divestFraction x totalShares), floored at 1).

totalAfterTax.description: After-tax proceeds from the divested shares, in dollars.

totalGross.description: Gross proceeds from the divested shares, in dollars.

totalShares.description: Total shares across all input lots.

totalTax.description: Total plan tax across all years (federal LTCG + NIIT + state, net of in-plan loss carryforward), in dollars.
